by_category:
def by_category(state) do
  state
  |> Map.get("expenses", [])
  |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn e, acc ->
    Map.update(acc, e["category"], to_cents(e["amount"]), fn sum -> sum + to_cents(e["amount"]) end)
  end)
  |> Enum.map(fn {cat, cents} -> {cat, to_dollars(cents)} end)
  |> Enum.sort()
  |> Map.new()
end
over_budget:
def over_budget(state) do
  spent = by_category(state)
  state
  |> Map.get("budgets", %{})
  |> Enum.filter(fn {cat, budget} -> Map.get(spent, cat, 0) > budget end)
  |> Enum.map(fn {cat, _budget} -> cat end)
  |> Enum.sort()
end
to_dollars:
defp to_dollars(cents) do
  if rem(cents, 100) == 0, do: div(cents, 100), else: cents / 100
end
top_category:
def top_category(state) do
  state
  |> by_category()
  |> Enum.map(fn {cat, amount} -> {cat, to_cents(amount)} end)
  |> Enum.sort()
  |> case do
    [] -> nil
    list -> list |> Enum.max_by(fn {_cat, cents} -> cents end) |> elem(0)
  end
end
total:
def total(state) do
  cents =
    state
    |> Map.get("expenses", [])
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn e, acc -> acc + to_cents(e["amount"]) end)
  to_dollars(cents)
end
